meta.title: 作文押题 26 篇
meta.desc: 押题精选 26 道原题 + 配套范文

items.title: 在职群体参加继续学习的目的
items.en: purposes of continuing education among employees

blocks.v: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of continuing education among working adults are distributed. Improving current job skills takes the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by learning about new fields and developing personal interests at 48% and 37% respectively, while obtaining qualifications comes last at 26%. Respondents could select more than one purpose.

sents.en: The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of continuing education among working adults are distributed.
sents.cn: 该柱状图清晰地展示了在职成人参加继续教育的目的分布。

sents.en: Improving current job skills takes the lead, accounting for 65%, followed by learning about new fields and developing personal interests at 48% and 37% respectively, while obtaining qualifications comes last at 26%.
sents.cn: 提升现有工作技能遥遥领先，占65%；其后是学习新领域和发展个人兴趣，分别占48%和37%；而获得资格证书位居最后，占26%。

sents.en: Respondents could select more than one purpose.
sents.cn: 受访者可以选择不止一个目的。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that changing job requirements encourage employees to update their knowledge and practical skills. Equally important, learning about new fields may create opportunities for career development. A further driver is the growing recognition that education can enrich life beyond the workplace. The findings therefore suggest that continuing education serves both professional needs and personal aspirations.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that changing job requirements encourage employees to update their knowledge and practical skills.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，不断变化的工作要求促使员工更新知识和实践技能。

swap.tips: 首要原因这层不动；两条都把「技能在变」写具体，别提前抢 48%／37% 那两项

alts.en: Primary among these is that the skills demanded at work keep changing, so employees must keep their knowledge current.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，工作所需的技能不断变化，员工必须让自己的知识保持更新。

alts.en: Primary among these is the pressure to stay useful: as tasks grow more demanding, employees come back to update what they know.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是保持自身有用的压力：随着任务要求提高，员工回来更新自己的知识。

sents.en: Equally important, learning about new fields may create opportunities for career development.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，学习新领域可能带来职业发展的机会。

swap.tips: 连接词不动，只换后面；换证书＝补上 26% 那项，48% 新领域就不再提，二选一

alts.en: Equally important, a recognised certificate gives employers tangible proof of a candidate's competence.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，一份受认可的证书能让雇主对应聘者的能力有实实在在的判断依据。

alts.en: Equally important, formal qualifications remain a basic requirement for promotion in many industries.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，在许多行业，正式学历与资格仍是晋升的基本要求。

alts.en: Equally important, certificates give workers the confidence to change careers or apply for better posts.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，证书让员工有底气转行，或去申请更好的职位。

sents.en: A further driver is the growing recognition that education can enrich life beyond the workplace.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，人们越来越认识到教育能丰富工作之外的生活。

swap.tips: A further driver is the 保持不动；三条都落在「工作之外」，别写成升职加薪

alts.en: A further driver is the wish to relieve work-related stress and strike a better balance between work and personal life.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，人们希望缓解工作压力，在工作与个人生活之间取得更好的平衡。

alts.en: A further driver is the search for a fuller spiritual life beyond salary and promotion.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，人们在薪酬与晋升之外寻求更充实的精神生活。

alts.en: A further driver is the growing sense that a serious hobby can even turn into a second career.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，越来越多人意识到，认真经营的爱好甚至能发展成第二职业。

sents.en: The findings therefore suggest that continuing education serves both professional needs and personal aspirations.
sents.cn: 因此，这些发现表明，继续教育既满足职业需求，也满足个人追求。

swap.tips: 第二段收口；两条都得把「职业 + 个人」两条线留住，不能只写一边

alts.en: The findings therefore suggest that further study meets needs that the workplace alone cannot satisfy.
alts.cn: 这些发现因此表明，继续教育满足了单靠职场无法满足的需求。

alts.en: The findings therefore suggest that continuing education pays off both at work and away from it.
alts.cn: 这些发现因此表明，继续教育既在工作中、也在工作之外带来回报。

blocks.v: On balance, learners return to study with a diverse range of purposes. However, practical needs clearly dominate. Employers can provide on-the-job training, while individuals should select courses that align with their personal goals. Ultimately, by meeting these diverse demands, lifelong learning will surely bring far-reaching benefits to both individuals and society.

sents.en: On balance, learners return to study with a diverse range of purposes.
sents.cn: 总的来说，学习者带着各种各样的目的重返课堂。

swap.tips: 默认保留 On balance 骨架起句（蓝色高亮）；备选换成 Overall 等说法，都只说「目的多样」，不预判哪一项占优

alts.en: Overall, learners return to study with a diverse range of purposes.
alts.cn: 总体而言，学习者带着各种各样的目的重返课堂。

alts.en: In general, adults go back to the classroom for purposes of many different kinds.
alts.cn: 一般而言，成人回到课堂出于各种不同的目的。

sents.en: However, practical needs clearly dominate.
sents.cn: 然而，实际需求显然占据了主导地位。

swap.tips: 承接首段 65% 技能遥遥领先；不写「差距大」——图上只是各项占比不同，不是差距评价

alts.en: Practical needs, though, clearly take the lead.
alts.cn: 不过，实际需求显然排在首位。

alts.en: Yet practical considerations clearly carry the most weight.
alts.cn: 然而，现实考量显然分量最重。

sents.en: Employers can provide on-the-job training, while individuals should select courses that align with their personal goals.
sents.cn: 雇主可以提供在职培训，而个人则应选择符合自身目标的课程。

swap.tips: 两条都抽掉本题专属词（在职培训／证书），留「机构提供便利 + 个人按实际内容选」的骨架，换任何教育培训题都能套

alts.en: Employers can make training easier to access, while individuals should choose courses by what they actually teach.
alts.cn: 雇主可以让培训更容易获得，而个人应按课程实际教的内容来选课。

alts.en: Those who run courses should make them easy to join, while learners should judge a programme by what it really offers.
alts.cn: 办课的一方应让课程更容易参加，而学习者应按一门课真正提供的东西来判断它。

sents.en: Ultimately, by meeting these diverse demands, lifelong learning will surely bring far-reaching benefits to both individuals and society.
sents.cn: 最终，通过满足这些多样化的需求，终身学习必将为个人和社会带来深远的益处。

swap.tips: 默认 A＝by meeting… 拔高到个人与社会；第一条备选＝版本 B 的 only when 倒装，强调真正价值；二选一，别混用

alts.en: Ultimately, only when these diverse learning needs are met can further study deliver its true value.
alts.cn: 归根结底，只有满足这些多样化的学习需求，继续教育才能发挥真正的价值。

alts.en: Ultimately, only when these needs are properly supported can further study deliver its true value to both learners and society.
alts.cn: 归根结底，只有这些需求得到恰当支持，继续教育才能为学习者与社会带来真正的价值。

items.title: 燃油车与新能源汽车国内销量
items.en: domestic sales of fuel and new energy vehicles

blocks.v: The table above clearly illustrates the changes in fuel and new energy vehicle sales from January to June 2025. During this period, sales of new energy vehicles rose from 0.79 to 1.12 million, despite a dip in April shared by both types. The figure for fuel vehicles fluctuated, peaking at 1.33 million in March, but slumped to 1.04 million in April. New energy vehicles overtook fuel vehicles in May, but the latter regained the lead in June.

sents.en: The table above clearly illustrates the changes in fuel and new energy vehicle sales from January to June 2025.
sents.cn: 上表清晰地展示了2025年1月至6月燃油车与新能源汽车销量的变化。

sents.en: During this period, sales of new energy vehicles rose from 0.79 to 1.12 million, despite a dip in April shared by both types.
sents.cn: 在此期间，新能源汽车销量从79万辆升至112万辆，尽管4月两类车销量均有所回落。

sents.en: The figure for fuel vehicles fluctuated, peaking at 1.33 million in March, but slumped to 1.04 million in April.
sents.cn: 相比之下，燃油车销量有所波动，3月达到133万辆的峰值，但4月骤降至104万辆。

sents.en: New energy vehicles overtook fuel vehicles in May, but the latter regained the lead in June.
sents.cn: 5月新能源汽车销量反超燃油车，但6月后者重新领先。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that improvements in batteries and charging facilities have made new energy vehicles more attractive to buyers. Equally important, lower running costs may encourage consumers to consider these models. A further driver is the lasting appeal of fuel vehicles to those valuing familiar technology or lacking convenient charging. The figures thus suggest growing competition between the two categories.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that improvements in batteries and charging facilities have made new energy vehicles more attractive to buyers.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，电池和充电设施的改善使新能源汽车对消费者更有吸引力。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·电池与充电
swap.tips: 首要原因＝技术条件成熟；别写成补贴政策，policy 留给第三段

alts.en: Primary among these is that better batteries and a denser charging network have removed the worries that once kept buyers away.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，更好的电池与更密集的充电网络消除了曾让买家却步的顾虑。

alts.en: Primary among these is that falling battery costs and easier charging have turned electric models into a practical choice for ordinary families.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，电池成本下降与充电更加便利，使电动车型成为普通家庭的现实选择。

sents.en: Equally important, lower running costs may encourage consumers to consider these models.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，更低的使用成本可能促使消费者考虑这些车型。

swap.tips: 成本角度，两条都落在「日常花钱少」；别扩到环保意识

alts.en: Equally important, charging at home costs far less than filling a tank, which makes the switch easier to justify.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，在家充电比加满一箱油便宜得多，这让换车更容易说得过去。

alts.en: Equally important, fuel and maintenance bills are lighter for electric cars, and that saving weighs heavily in many purchase decisions.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，电动车的燃料与保养开支更轻，这笔节省在许多购车决定中分量很重。

sents.en: A further driver is the lasting appeal of fuel vehicles to those valuing familiar technology or lacking convenient charging.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，传统燃油车对看重成熟技术或充电不便的人群仍有持久的吸引力。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·燃油车惯性
swap.tips: 解释燃油车为什么没被取代，语气客观，不贬低电动车

alts.en: A further driver is that many drivers still trust the technology they know, especially where charging points are scarce.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，许多驾驶者仍然信任自己熟悉的技术，在充电桩稀少的地方尤其如此。

alts.en: A further driver is the simple fact that a petrol car can be refuelled anywhere, which keeps it the safer choice for long trips.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，燃油车随处可以加油，这让它在长途出行中仍是更稳妥的选择。

sents.en: The figures thus suggest growing competition between the two categories.
sents.cn: 因此，这些数据表明两类车之间的竞争日益加剧。

swap.tips: 收「两类在竞争」，别写成电动车已经赢了（6 月燃油车反超）

alts.en: The figures thus suggest that the two categories are now competing for the same buyers.
alts.cn: 这些数据因此表明，两类车型如今在争夺同一批买家。

alts.en: The figures thus suggest a market where the two categories take turns at the top.
alts.cn: 这些数据因此表明，市场上两类车型正轮流占据领先位置。

blocks.v: On balance, the trend in the figures is worth welcoming. Admittedly, there are ups and downs, but a small dip does not change the big picture. Policy support and lower costs keep the change going. Companies should improve their products, and the authorities should provide better services. The development of new energy vehicles deserves continued support.

sents.en: On balance, the trend in the figures is worth welcoming.
sents.cn: 总的来说，图里的趋势值得欢迎。

swap.tips: 表态即可；换成「对消费者有利」或「方向令人鼓舞」，别再搬 welcome one 的旧写法

alts.en: On balance, this change is good news for consumers.
alts.cn: 总的来说，这个变化对消费者来说是好消息。

alts.en: The shift these figures reveal is a healthy one.
alts.cn: 这些数字反映的变化是健康的。

sents.en: Admittedly, there are ups and downs, but a small dip does not change the big picture.
sents.cn: 诚然，数据有涨有跌，但一次小幅回落不会改变大局。

swap.tips: 不提具体月份：一条说「整体重于单月」，一条说「暂时回落只是长过程的一环」

alts.en: The direction over the whole period matters more than one dip.
alts.cn: 整个时期的方向，比一次回落更重要。

alts.en: A temporary setback is only part of a longer process.
alts.cn: 暂时的回落只是更长过程中的一小段。

sents.en: Policy support and lower costs keep the change going.
sents.cn: 政策支持和更低的成本让这个变化持续下去。

swap.tips: 一条从「技术变便宜、买得起」说，一条从「需求反过来推动厂商」说，别都讲政策

alts.en: Cheaper technology is putting such products within reach of more buyers.
alts.cn: 更便宜的技术让更多买家买得起这类产品。

alts.en: Growing demand is pushing producers to improve what they offer.
alts.cn: 需求增长正推动厂商改进自己的产品。

sents.en: Companies should improve their products, and the authorities should provide better services.
sents.cn: 企业要改进产品，主管部门要提供更好的服务。

swap.tips: 企业 + 主管部门各一条；一条「质量+规则」，一条「价格合理+设施」，抽掉本题专属词

alts.en: Producers should focus on quality, while regulators should make the rules clear.
alts.cn: 生产方应注重质量，监管方应把规则讲清楚。

alts.en: Firms should keep prices reasonable and the government should build the needed facilities.
alts.cn: 企业应保持价格合理，政府应建好所需设施。

sents.en: The development of new energy vehicles deserves continued support.
sents.cn: 新能源汽车的发展值得持续支持。

swap.tips: 扣题落到「新能源的发展」；两条备选分别说「值得期待」「会走得更稳」，语气别重样

alts.en: The development of new energy vehicles deserves to be watched with confidence.
alts.cn: 新能源汽车的发展值得满怀信心地期待。

alts.en: New energy vehicles are likely to develop more steadily in the years ahead.
alts.cn: 新能源汽车未来几年有望发展得更稳。

items.title: 居民日常出行选择
items.en: residents' daily travel choices

blocks.v: The chart above clearly illustrates the changes in daily transport choices in a city from 2015 to 2021. During this period, the proportion of residents choosing buses fell from just over 50% to under 30%. By contrast, the figure for ride-hailing services and shared bicycles rose to approximately a quarter each. Private cars and other forms of transport recorded smaller declines.

sents.en: The chart above clearly illustrates the changes in daily transport choices in a city from 2015 to 2021.
sents.cn: 上图清晰地展示了2015年至2021年某市居民日常出行方式的变化。

sents.en: During this period, the proportion of residents choosing buses fell from just over 50% to under 30%.
sents.cn: 在此期间，选择公交出行的居民比例从略高于50%下降到不足30%。

sents.en: By contrast, the figure for ride-hailing services and shared bicycles rose to approximately a quarter each.
sents.cn: 相比之下，网约车和共享单车的占比均上升到约四分之一。

sents.en: Private cars and other forms of transport recorded smaller declines.
sents.cn: 私家车和其他出行方式的降幅较小。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that mobile applications have made it easier to arrange a ride or locate a bicycle. Equally important, shared bicycles offer a convenient option for short journeys, while ride-hailing services can meet more flexible travel needs. The figures suggest that residents have gained a wider range of transport choices.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that mobile applications have made it easier to arrange a ride or locate a bicycle.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，手机应用让叫车或找单车变得更方便。

swap.tips: 技术便利这层不动；两条都写「一块屏幕就能办」，别扯价格战

alts.en: Primary among these is that a few taps on a phone are now enough to book a car or unlock a bicycle.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，如今在手机上点几下就能叫到车或解锁一辆单车。

alts.en: Primary among these is that ride-hailing and shared bikes are both reached through the screen people already carry.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，网约车与共享单车都能通过人们随身携带的那块屏幕获得。

sents.en: Equally important, shared bicycles offer a convenient option for short journeys, while ride-hailing services can meet more flexible travel needs.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，共享单车为短途出行提供了便利选择，网约车则能满足更灵活的出行需求。

swap.tips: 「短途用单车、长途叫车」的分工不能塌；替换句也要各给一个场景

alts.en: Equally important, bicycles suit the short trip to the subway, while ride-hailing covers the longer or later journeys that buses serve poorly.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，单车适合到地铁站的短途，而网约车覆盖公交难以顾及的较长或较晚的出行。

alts.en: Equally important, the two options divide the work between them: bicycles for the last kilometre, cars for trips with bags or an awkward hour.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，这两种方式各司其职：单车负责最后一公里，汽车负责带行李或时间不凑巧的出行。

sents.en: The figures suggest that residents have gained a wider range of transport choices.
sents.cn: 这些数据表明，居民的出行选择变得更加丰富。

swap.tips: 中性的「选择变多」，不评价好坏——好与不好留给第三段

alts.en: The figures suggest that residents now choose a way to travel according to the trip rather than the timetable.
alts.cn: 这些数据表明，居民如今是按出行需要、而不是按时刻表来选择出行方式。

alts.en: The figures suggest that residents are no longer limited to the bus when they leave home.
alts.cn: 这些数据表明，居民出门时不再只能依赖公交。

blocks.v: On balance, the wider choice of travel is a real gain for daily life. Admittedly, the fall in bus use deserves attention, since many people still rely on it. New services should add to existing options rather than replace them. Authorities should keep basic routes sound while letting new options grow. Everyday travel should serve the neediest most.

sents.en: On balance, the wider choice of travel is a real gain for daily life.
sents.cn: 总的来说，出行方式变多是日常生活的一大收获。

swap.tips: 正面表态：选择变多是收获；备选分别落在「多数人方便」和「城市进步」

alts.en: For most people the wider range of options simply makes everyday trips easier.
alts.cn: 对多数人来说，选择变多就是让日常出行更方便。

alts.en: Having more ways to travel is a step forward for the city as a whole.
alts.cn: 出行方式变多，对整个城市来说是一大进步。

sents.en: Admittedly, the fall in bus use deserves attention, since many people still rely on it.
sents.cn: 诚然，公交使用量下降值得关注，因为许多人仍依赖它。

swap.tips: 承认公交下滑；A 为简单版，B 用 What 主语从句升级（加分句式），分别落在「别只看数字」和「依赖公交者被忽略」

alts.en: The drop in bus use does not mean buses matter less now.
alts.cn: 公交使用量下降并不表示公交变得不重要。

alts.en: What the figures do not show is how many people have no alternative to the bus.
alts.cn: 数字没有显示的是，有多少人除了公交别无选择。

sents.en: New services should add to existing options rather than replace them.
sents.cn: 新服务应补充现有方式，而不是取代它们。

swap.tips: 新方式补充而非替代；骨架抽掉具体车种，任何新旧服务都能用

alts.en: Fresh options work best when existing services are kept intact.
alts.cn: 现有服务保持完好时，新方式才能发挥最大作用。

alts.en: New modes should grow alongside the old ones, not at their expense.
alts.cn: 新方式应与旧方式一起发展，而不是挤掉它们。

sents.en: Authorities should keep basic routes sound while letting new options grow.
sents.cn: 主管部门应保持基本线路完好，同时让新方式发展。

swap.tips: 主管部门兜住基本线路；备选分别落在「兜底」和「新旧衔接」

alts.en: The authorities should keep essential routes running for those who need them.
alts.cn: 主管部门应为有需要的人保住基本线路。

alts.en: The city should make sure basic lines remain reliable while new services find their place.
alts.cn: 城市应让基本线路保持可靠，同时给新服务留位置。

sents.en: Everyday travel should serve the neediest most.
sents.cn: 日常出行最应服务于最需要的人。

swap.tips: 扣「出行公平」题眼，不写空指；备选落在「惠及所有人」和「最弱势者可用」

alts.en: Travel is genuinely better only when its benefits reach every group of residents.
alts.cn: 只有当好处惠及每一类居民，出行才算真正变好。

alts.en: The measure of a good transport system is whether the least mobile can still use it.
alts.cn: 衡量交通好不好，看的是最不方便的人能否照常用它。

items.title: 大学生择业考虑因素
items.en: factors in college students' career choices

blocks.v: The chart above clearly illustrates how the factors considered by university students when choosing a job are distributed. Personal development prospects top the list at 65%, followed by pay at 53%. Company reputation is mentioned by 31%, followed by personal interests at 22%, while the working environment comes last at 9%.

sents.en: The chart above clearly illustrates how the factors considered by university students when choosing a job are distributed.
sents.cn: 上图清晰地展示了某高校学生在择业时考虑的各项因素的分布。

sents.en: Personal development prospects top the list at 65%, followed by pay at 53%.
sents.cn: 个人发展前景以65%位居首位，其次是薪酬，占53%。

sents.en: Company reputation is mentioned by 31%, followed by personal interests at 22%, while the working environment comes last at 9%.
sents.cn: 公司声誉被31%的人提到，其次是个人兴趣，占22%；工作环境排在最后，占9%。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that graduates need opportunities to acquire skills and build a sustainable career, which helps explain the emphasis on development prospects. Equally important, pay matters because young employees must meet their daily expenses and gradually achieve financial independence. A further driver is the promise of valuable experience and recognition at a well-known employer. Nevertheless, the relatively low figures for interests and the working environment deserve attention, since both can influence motivation and job satisfaction.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that graduates need opportunities to acquire skills and build a sustainable career, which helps explain the emphasis on development prospects.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，毕业生需要机会获得技能并建立可持续的职业生涯，这有助于解释为何人们重视发展前景。

swap.tips: 65% 的发展前景是第一位因素；两条都别把薪酬写成第一位

alts.en: Primary among these is that a first job is now judged by what it teaches, so prospects outrank everything else.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，如今衡量第一份工作的标准是它能教给人什么，因此发展前景压过其他一切。

alts.en: Primary among these is that graduates treat the first post as a place to grow, not merely a place to earn.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，毕业生把第一份工作看作成长的地方，而不仅仅是挣钱的地方。

sents.en: Equally important, pay matters because young employees must meet their daily expenses and gradually achieve financial independence.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，薪酬很重要，因为年轻员工必须满足日常开支并逐步实现经济独立。

swap.tips: 53% 排第二；把「为什么钱重要」写实（房租、独立），别写成拜金

alts.en: Equally important, rent and daily bills arrive every month, so a decent salary is a condition of independence.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，房租与日常开销每月都会到来，因此一份体面的薪水是独立的前提。

alts.en: Equally important, salary still decides how soon graduates can stop relying on their parents.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，薪资仍然决定毕业生多久才能不再依赖父母。

sents.en: A further driver is the promise of valuable experience and recognition at a well-known employer.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是知名雇主可能带来的宝贵经验和认可。

swap.tips: 31% 的公司声誉；两条都落在「简历与学习机会」，不写薪资

alts.en: A further driver is the weight a familiar name carries on a CV and the training that comes with it.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是知名企业在简历上的分量，以及随之而来的培训。

alts.en: A further driver is that a well-known employer offers both a recognised brand and a chance to learn from experienced colleagues.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，知名雇主既提供被认可的品牌，也提供向有经验的同事学习的机会。

sents.en: Nevertheless, the relatively low figures for interests and the working environment deserve attention, since both can influence motivation and job satisfaction.
sents.cn: 尽管如此，兴趣和工作环境占比较低值得关注，因为两者都会影响积极性和工作满意度。

swap.tips: 兴趣 22%、环境 9% 是最低两项；替换句两条都必须点出「两项都低」

alts.en: Nevertheless, the low priority given to personal interest and to the working environment is worth pausing over, as both shape how long a graduate stays.
alts.cn: 然而，个人兴趣与工作环境被排得较低，这一点值得停下来想一想，因为二者都影响毕业生能干多久。

alts.en: Nevertheless, interest and atmosphere score poorly here, and both decide whether a job feels worth keeping.
alts.cn: 然而，兴趣与氛围在这里得分很低，而这两点决定一份工作是否值得长期做下去。

blocks.v: On balance, the figures show what graduates want most from a job. Long-term growth comes first, with pay close behind. This is understandable when young people face tough competition for jobs. Universities should help students judge an offer by more than its starting salary. A career built on lasting prospects is worth more than a quick gain.

sents.en: On balance, the figures show what graduates want most from a job.
sents.cn: 总的来说，这些数字显示了毕业生找工作最看重什么。

swap.tips: 中性表态：数字显示择业最看重什么；备选落在「优先次序清晰」和「择业更务实」

alts.en: On balance, the survey makes the order of priorities clear.
alts.cn: 总的来说，这份调查让毕业生的优先次序清楚可见。

alts.en: Taken together, the figures show that graduates choose with practical goals in mind.
alts.cn: 总体来看，这些数字显示毕业生择业时心里有现实的目标。

sents.en: Long-term growth comes first, with pay close behind.
sents.cn: 长期发展排第一，薪酬紧随其后。

swap.tips: 发展第一、薪酬第二；备选换角度不换次序，别把薪酬写成第一

alts.en: What ranks first is room to grow, and salary follows not far behind.
alts.cn: 排在第一位的是成长空间，薪酬紧跟在后面。

alts.en: Graduates put future development ahead of pay, though pay is still near the top.
alts.cn: 毕业生把长远发展放在薪酬之前，不过薪酬仍排在前列。

sents.en: This is understandable when young people face tough competition for jobs.
sents.cn: 年轻人面对激烈的求职竞争时，这可以理解。

swap.tips: 解释「为什么可理解」；备选落在「年轻人看得远」和「就业竞争使然」

alts.en: This makes sense when young people look beyond the first pay cheque.
alts.cn: 年轻人在意的不只是第一份薪水时，这就说得通了。

alts.en: Fierce competition for jobs is what lies behind such caution.
alts.cn: 求职竞争激烈，正是这种谨慎背后的原因。

sents.en: Universities should help students judge an offer by more than its starting salary.
sents.cn: 大学应帮助学生评价一份工作，而不只是看起薪。

swap.tips: 学校帮学生看工作不只看起薪；备选落在「课程教判断」和「学生自己权衡」

alts.en: Universities should teach students to weigh a whole offer, not just the salary line.
alts.cn: 大学应教学生权衡一份工作的整体，而不只是薪资那一行。

alts.en: Students themselves need to look past the starting salary when they compare offers.
alts.cn: 学生在比较工作机会时，自己也要越过起薪去看。

sents.en: A career built on lasting prospects is worth more than a quick gain.
sents.cn: 建立在长远前景上的职业，比眼前的高薪更值得。

swap.tips: 扣「长远发展＞眼前高薪」题眼；备选落在「别只看起薪」和「成长比待遇重要」

alts.en: A job chosen for the long run is a better bet than one chosen for a high first salary.
alts.cn: 为长远选的工作，比为高起薪选的工作更划算。

alts.en: In the end, room to grow counts for more than a tempting starting wage.
alts.cn: 归根到底，成长空间比诱人的起薪更值。

items.title: 全国便利店门店数量
items.en: the number of convenience stores nationwide

blocks.v: The chart above clearly illustrates the changes in the number of convenience stores in China from 2015 to 2023. During this period, the total rose from roughly 90,000 to approximately 320,000. Growth was relatively modest up to 2019, while the years thereafter brought a sharp acceleration, indicating the expansion of this retail sector.

sents.en: The chart above clearly illustrates the changes in the number of convenience stores in China from 2015 to 2023.
sents.cn: 上图清晰地展示了2015年至2023年中国便利店门店数量的变化。

sents.en: During this period, the total rose from roughly 90,000 to approximately 320,000.
sents.cn: 在此期间，总数从约9万家增长到约32万家。

sents.en: Growth was relatively modest up to 2019, while the years thereafter brought a sharp acceleration, indicating the expansion of this retail sector.
sents.cn: 2019年之前增长较为温和，此后几年则明显加快，表明这一零售业正在扩张。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that busy urban lifestyles have created demand for nearby shops where people can purchase daily necessities quickly. Equally important, longer opening hours and a convenient range of products make these stores attractive to consumers. A further driver is that improvements in distribution networks and inventory management have helped businesses operate more efficiently and open additional outlets. Together, these factors offer possible explanations for the rising number of stores.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that busy urban lifestyles have created demand for nearby shops where people can purchase daily necessities quickly.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，忙碌的城市生活使人们需要附近能快速买到日用品的店铺。

swap.tips: 需求端原因；两条都写「城市节奏快、要近」，别写成店铺自己会经营

alts.en: Primary among these is that city dwellers rarely have time for a long trip to the supermarket, so they buy close to home.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，城市居民很少有时间跑远去超市，因此就在家附近购买。

alts.en: Primary among these is the pace of urban life, which rewards the shop two minutes away over the one twenty minutes away.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是城市生活的节奏，它让两分钟就能到的店胜过二十分钟才到的店。

sents.en: Equally important, longer opening hours and a convenient range of products make these stores attractive to consumers.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，营业时间更长、商品种类便利，使这些店对消费者有吸引力。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·营业时间与货品
swap.tips: 供给端便利；两条都落在「随时买得到、买得对」，别提前讲供应链

alts.en: Equally important, these shops stay open when other stores are shut, and stock exactly what a household runs out of.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，别的店关门时它们还开着，而且恰好备着家里会用完的东西。

alts.en: Equally important, a late-night snack, a bottle of water or a phone charger can all be bought without a detour.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，深夜的零食、一瓶水或一个充电器，都能顺路买到，不必绕道。

sents.en: A further driver is that improvements in distribution networks and inventory management have helped businesses operate more efficiently and open additional outlets.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，配送网络和库存管理的改善帮助企业更高效地经营并开设更多门店。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·供应链效率
swap.tips: 经营端原因；两条都讲「开一家店更省」，别重复前一句的营业时间

alts.en: A further driver is that modern logistics and stock control let one outlet be run with fewer staff and less waste.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，现代物流与库存管理使一家门店能用更少的人手、更少的损耗运营。

alts.en: A further driver is that a mature supply chain makes opening the next store cheaper than it used to be.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，成熟的供应链让再开一家店的成本比过去更低。

sents.en: Together, these factors offer possible explanations for the rising number of stores.
sents.cn: 综合来看，这些因素为门店数量的增长提供了可能的解释。

swap.tips: Together 收口；两条都收「几股力量合起来」，别写成单一原因

alts.en: Together, these forces account for the rapid spread of such stores across cities.
alts.cn: 这些力量共同解释了这类门店在城市中的迅速铺开。

alts.en: Together, they explain why the number of outlets has climbed so steeply in a few years.
alts.cn: 它们共同解释了门店数量为何在几年间攀升得如此之快。

blocks.v: On balance, the steady growth of convenience stores is a welcome change. More outlets bring daily shopping within easier reach of many residents. Yet size alone says little about whether the service really fits local life. Operators should shape their offer around the people they serve. These stores add the most when they answer a real local need.

sents.en: On balance, the steady growth of convenience stores is a welcome change.
sents.cn: 总的来说，便利店稳步增长是一个可喜的变化。

swap.tips: 正面表态：稳步增长可喜；备选落在「日常更方便」和「社区商业有活力」

alts.en: On balance, more convenience stores make daily shopping easier for local residents.
alts.cn: 总的来说，便利店变多让本地居民日常购物更方便。

alts.en: Taken as a whole, the steady rise of such shops is a sign of a lively neighbourhood trade.
alts.cn: 总体来看，这类门店稳步增加，是社区商业有活力的表现。

sents.en: More outlets bring daily shopping within easier reach of many residents.
sents.cn: 门店多了，许多居民日常购物更近、更方便。

swap.tips: 门店多了购物更近；备选落在「省时」和「覆盖更多居民」

alts.en: With more shops nearby, residents spend less time on an ordinary shopping trip.
alts.cn: 附近门店多了，居民日常购物花的时间更少。

alts.en: The growing number of outlets puts everyday goods within reach of more people.
alts.cn: 门店增多，让更多人能就近买到日常用品。

sents.en: Yet size alone says little about whether the service really fits local life.
sents.cn: 但只看数量说明不了服务是否贴合当地生活。

swap.tips: 只看数量说明不了服务好坏；备选落在「数量之外看服务」和「便利要看实际」

alts.en: A larger number of shops, however, tells us little about the quality of the service.
alts.cn: 然而，门店数量多了，说明不了服务的质量。

alts.en: What matters is not how many shops there are but how well they serve the people nearby.
alts.cn: 重要的不是有多少家店，而是它们把周边居民服务得多好。

sents.en: Operators should shape their offer around the people they serve.
sents.cn: 经营者应按所服务人群的需求来安排生意。

swap.tips: 按所服务人群安排生意；备选落在「按需调整」和「做出特色」

alts.en: Operators should adjust what they sell to the needs of the people around them.
alts.cn: 经营者应按周边人群的需求调整所卖的东西。

alts.en: Shop owners would do better to give their store a character of its own.
alts.cn: 店主不妨让自己的店做出自己的特色。

sents.en: These stores add the most when they answer a real local need.
sents.cn: 这些店满足了当地真实需求，价值才最大。

swap.tips: 扣「满足本地需求」题眼；备选落在「服务社区有价值」和「扎根社区是根本」

alts.en: Such shops are worth most when they meet a real need of the community.
alts.cn: 这类门店满足社区真实需求时，价值才最大。

alts.en: Their lasting value lies in becoming a part of everyday local life.
alts.cn: 它们长久的价值，在于成为当地日常生活的一部分。

items.title: 新生朋辈指导项目：介绍与回复
items.en: a peer mentoring programme: introduction and reply

blocks.v: Dear Michael,

sents.en: Dear Michael,
sents.cn: 亲爱的迈克尔：

blocks.v: Thanks for your email. I am writing to tell you more about our peer mentoring program for new students.

sents.en: Thanks for your email.
sents.cn: 谢谢你的邮件。

swap.tips: 回信第一句，简短就好，别在寒暄上堆词

alts.en: Thank you for your email.
alts.cn: 感谢你的来信。

alts.en: It was good to hear from you.
alts.cn: 收到你的消息很高兴。

sents.en: I am writing to tell you more about our peer mentoring program for new students.
sents.cn: 我写信是想更多介绍我们为新生设立的朋辈指导项目。

swap.tips: 第二句说清这封信要做什么，收信人一眼就知道重点

alts.en: Let me tell you more about our peer mentoring program for new students.
alts.cn: 我再和你详细说说面向新生的朋辈指导项目。

alts.en: This email is to explain how our peer mentoring program works for new students.
alts.cn: 这封邮件是要说明我们的新生朋辈指导项目如何运作。

blocks.v: The details can be listed as follows. Each new student is paired with a senior student who offers advice on courses and campus life. Weekly meetings provide opportunities to discuss study methods and share experiences. Group activities also help you make friends and become familiar with university services. If you are interested, you can register at the department office before Friday.

sents.en: The details can be listed as follows.
sents.cn: 具体细节可列举如下。

swap.tips: 下面要分条说，用一句过渡把结构交代清楚

alts.en: The main points are as follows.
alts.cn: 主要情况如下。

alts.en: Here is how it works.
alts.cn: 具体是这样运作的。

sents.en: Each new student is paired with a senior student who offers advice on courses and campus life.
sents.cn: 每位新生会与一名高年级学生结对，由后者就课程和校园生活提供建议。

sents.en: Weekly meetings provide opportunities to discuss study methods and share experiences.
sents.cn: 每周的会面为讨论学习方法和分享经验提供机会。

sents.en: Group activities also help you make friends and become familiar with university services.
sents.cn: 团体活动还能帮你交朋友，并熟悉学校的各项服务。

sents.en: If you are interested, you can register at the department office before Friday.
sents.cn: 如果你有兴趣，可以在周五前到系办公室报名。

blocks.v: For more information about the program, please do not hesitate to contact me. I hope you will find it helpful.

sents.en: For more information about the program, please do not hesitate to contact me.
sents.cn: 如需进一步了解该项目，请随时与我联系。

sents.en: I hope you will find it helpful.
sents.cn: 希望这些信息对你有帮助。

blocks.v: Yours sincerely,

sents.en: Yours sincerely,
sents.cn: 谨启，

blocks.v: Li Ming

sents.en: Li Ming
sents.cn: 李明

items.title: 中国文化演讲：建议与安排
items.en: a lecture on Chinese culture: suggestions and arrangements

blocks.v: Dear Jane,

sents.en: Dear Jane,
sents.cn: 亲爱的简：

blocks.v: I was delighted to receive your email about the speech contest. I am writing to offer some suggestions.

sents.en: I was delighted to receive your email about the speech contest.
sents.cn: 很高兴收到你关于演讲比赛的邮件。

swap.tips: 回应对方来信，顺带点出话题（演讲比赛）

alts.en: It was a pleasure to receive your email about the speech contest.
alts.cn: 很高兴收到你关于演讲比赛的信。

alts.en: I was glad to hear from you about the speech contest.
alts.cn: 很高兴你来信谈起演讲比赛的事。

sents.en: I am writing to offer some suggestions.
sents.cn: 我写信是想提几点建议。

swap.tips: 建议信的标准来意句，可直接说「为演讲提几点建议」

alts.en: I am writing with a few suggestions for your speech.
alts.cn: 我写信是想为你的演讲提几点建议。

alts.en: Here are a few ideas that may help with your speech.
alts.cn: 这里有几点想法，或许对你的演讲有帮助。

blocks.v: I would highly recommend Chinese tea culture for its rich history and close connection with daily life. You could explain how serving tea expresses hospitality and share a personal experience. Using pictures of tea sets would also make your speech more engaging. As for our video call, would 7 p.m. Beijing time this Saturday be convenient for you?

sents.en: I would highly recommend Chinese tea culture for its rich history and close connection with daily life.
sents.cn: 我强烈推荐中国文化中的茶文化，因为它历史悠久且与日常生活紧密相连。

swap.tips: 推荐要给出理由，for 后面就是理由

alts.en: Chinese tea culture would be my first choice, given its long history and its place in everyday life.
alts.cn: 考虑到中国茶文化历史悠久且融入日常生活，我会首选它。

alts.en: I would suggest Chinese tea culture above all, as it has a long history and touches daily life.
alts.cn: 我首先推荐中国茶文化，因为它历史悠久，又与日常生活紧密相连。

sents.en: You could explain how serving tea expresses hospitality and share a personal experience.
sents.cn: 你可以讲讲奉茶如何表达待客之道，并分享一段个人经历。

sents.en: Using pictures of tea sets would also make your speech more engaging.
