notes.en: the share of public places with barrier-free passages in a city, 2021–2025

notes.zh: 注：无障碍通道指坡道、升降设施等便于行动不便者进出的通道
notes.en: Barrier-free passages refer to ramps, lifts and other facilities that help people with mobility difficulties get in and out.

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts a wheelchair user approaching a public building by an accessible route, while the chart above clearly illustrates the changes in accessibility from 2021 to 2025. During this period, the proportion of public places with accessible routes in a city rose steadily from 56% to 85%. Together, the two images highlight progress toward a more inclusive society.

sents.en: The cartoon above depicts a wheelchair user approaching a public building by an accessible route, while the chart above clearly illustrates the changes in accessibility from 2021 to 2025.
sents.cn: 上图描绘了一名轮椅使用者正沿无障碍通道走向一栋公共建筑，图表则清晰地展示了2021年至2025年无障碍设施的变化。

sents.en: During this period, the proportion of public places with accessible routes in a city rose steadily from 56% to 85%.
sents.cn: 在此期间，某市设有无障碍通道的公共场所比例从56%稳步上升到85%。

sents.en: Together, the two images highlight progress toward a more inclusive society.
sents.cn: 两幅材料共同彰显了社会走向更加包容的进步。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is the growing recognition that equal participation requires accessible facilities. Equally important, better planning and investment can help remove physical barriers in public spaces. A further driver is that ramps and lifts not only make travel easier for people with disabilities, but also benefit older adults and others with limited mobility. Such improvements protect dignity as well as provide practical convenience.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is the growing recognition that equal participation requires accessible facilities.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，人们越来越认识到平等参与需要无障碍设施。

swap.tips: 从「公共空间的含义」切入；两条都别变成工程细节

alts.en: Primary among these is a shift in how public space is understood: a city is not truly public if part of its population cannot enter.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是人们对公共空间理解的转变：如果一部分人进不去，城市就算不上真正的公共。

alts.en: Primary among these is the principle that everyone should be able to use the same entrance, not a separate one at the back.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是这样一个原则：每个人都应能走同一个入口，而不是后面另开的那个。

sents.en: Equally important, better planning and investment can help remove physical barriers in public spaces.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，更好的规划和投入有助于消除公共空间中的物理障碍。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·规划与投入
swap.tips: 规划与投入是条件；两条都写在「设计阶段/预算里」，别写成慈善捐赠

alts.en: Equally important, ramps, lifts and tactile paving are no longer afterthoughts but standard items in the building budget.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，坡道、电梯与盲道不再是事后补上的东西，而成了建设预算中的常规项目。

alts.en: Equally important, local governments now write accessibility into new projects from the design stage.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，地方政府如今在设计阶段就把无障碍要求写进新项目。

sents.en: A further driver is that ramps and lifts not only make travel easier for people with disabilities, but also benefit older adults and others with limited mobility.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，坡道和电梯不仅方便残障人士出行，也使老年人和其他行动不便者受益。

swap.tips: 受益面扩大是这条的核心；替换句也必须写到「不止轮椅使用者」

alts.en: A further driver is that a ramp serves far more people than the wheelchair users it was designed for: parents with prams and travellers with heavy luggage use it daily.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，坡道服务的人远不止它所针对的轮椅使用者：推婴儿车的父母与拖着大件行李的旅客每天都在用。

alts.en: A further driver is that accessibility turns out to help anyone who is temporarily slowed down by injury, age or luggage.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，无障碍设施最终惠及任何因受伤、年龄或行李而暂时行动不便的人。

sents.en: Such improvements protect dignity as well as provide practical convenience.
sents.cn: 这样的改善既维护了尊严，也提供了实实在在的便利。

swap.tips: 这句收「便利 + 尊严」两层，替换不要把尊严那层丢掉

alts.en: Such improvements offer convenience and, more importantly, restore the dignity of going out without asking for help.
alts.cn: 这类改善带来便利，更重要的是，恢复了无需求助就能出门的尊严。

alts.en: Such improvements do more than smooth a journey; they let people take part in public life on their own terms.
alts.cn: 这类改善不只是让出行更顺畅，更让人能按自己的方式参与公共生活。

blocks.v: On balance, the growth of accessible facilities is a welcome sign of a more inclusive society. Authorities should extend these facilities to more locations and ensure that existing routes remain unobstructed and well maintained. User feedback should also guide future designs, since it can reveal problems that planners overlook. Only through sustained attention can accessible facilities become reliable support in everyday life.

sents.en: On balance, the growth of accessible facilities is a welcome sign of a more inclusive society.
sents.cn: 总的来说，无障碍设施的增多是更包容社会的一个可喜迹象。

swap.tips: 正面表态后直接进入对策，不必再夸一遍数据

alts.en: On balance, more accessible facilities mark real progress towards a more inclusive society.
alts.cn: 总的来说，更多无障碍设施标志着迈向更包容社会的真实进步。

alts.en: Taken as a whole, the spread of accessible facilities shows a society becoming more inclusive.
alts.cn: 总体来看，无障碍设施的普及显示社会正变得更包容。

sents.en: Authorities should extend these facilities to more locations and ensure that existing routes remain unobstructed and well maintained.
sents.cn: 主管部门应把这些设施推广到更多场所，并确保现有通道畅通、维护良好。

swap.tips: 扩覆盖 + 保维护；骨架抽掉无障碍专属词，留「增点位、养护已有」

alts.en: The responsible bodies should widen coverage and keep existing provision well maintained.
alts.cn: 主管部门应扩大覆盖面，并让已有的设施保持良好维护。

alts.en: More locations should be equipped, and what is already there should stay unobstructed.
alts.cn: 更多场所应配备设施，已有的则应保持畅通。

sents.en: User feedback should also guide future designs, since it can reveal problems that planners overlook.
sents.cn: 使用者的反馈也应指导后续设计，因为它能发现规划者忽略的问题。

swap.tips: 用户反馈补盲点；「听使用者、补规划盲区」是通用骨架

alts.en: Feedback from users should shape later improvements, since it reveals what planners miss.
alts.cn: 使用者的反馈应指导日后的改进，因为它能发现规划者忽略的问题。

alts.en: Listening to the people who rely on a service can expose gaps that designers overlook.
alts.cn: 倾听依赖某项服务的人，能暴露设计者忽略的盲点。

sents.en: Only through sustained attention can accessible facilities become reliable support in everyday life.
sents.cn: 只有持续关注，无障碍设施才能真正成为日常生活的可靠支撑。

swap.tips: 「只有持续关注才能……」是条件式收尾，别写成空预测

alts.en: Accessible facilities will only become dependable in daily use if attention is sustained.
alts.cn: 只有持续关注，无障碍设施才会在日常使用中真正可靠。

alts.en: Sustained care is what turns accessible design into something people can rely on.
alts.cn: 正是持续的维护，让无障碍设计变成人们日常可依赖的东西。

items.title: 急救知识的普及
items.en: the popularisation of first-aid knowledge

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts a person teaching others a basic first-aid skill, while the chart above clearly illustrates the changes in participation in first-aid training from 2021 to 2025. During this period, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 in a city who received such training rose steadily from 9% to 32%. These materials highlight the spread of practical knowledge of emergency response.

sents.en: The cartoon above depicts a person teaching others a basic first-aid skill, while the chart above clearly illustrates the changes in participation in first-aid training from 2021 to 2025.
sents.cn: 上图描绘了一个人正在教他人一项基本急救技能，图表则清晰地展示了2021年至2025年参加急救培训人数的变化。

sents.en: During this period, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 in a city who received such training rose steadily from 9% to 32%.
sents.cn: 在此期间，某市18至60岁居民中接受过此类培训的比例从9%稳步上升到32%。

sents.en: These materials highlight the spread of practical knowledge of emergency response.
sents.cn: 这些材料凸显了应急实用知识的普及。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is the growing recognition that timely assistance can make a difference in an emergency. Equally important, accessible courses offered by communities and workplaces may encourage more residents to participate. A further driver is that practical training not only improves relevant skills, but also helps participants understand their limits and respond with greater confidence. However, the figures show that participation still has considerable room to grow.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is the growing recognition that timely assistance can make a difference in an emergency.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，人们越来越认识到及时救助在紧急情况下能起到关键作用。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·黄金几分钟
swap.tips: 「最初几分钟」是这条的支点；两条都别写成医院或设备

alts.en: Primary among these is a simple fact: in the first few minutes, the nearest bystander matters more than the ambulance.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是一个简单事实：在最初几分钟里，最近的路人比救护车更重要。

alts.en: Primary among these is the awareness that survival often depends on what a passer-by does before help arrives.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，人们意识到能否活下来常常取决于路人在救援到来之前的所作所为。

sents.en: Equally important, accessible courses offered by communities and workplaces may encourage more residents to participate.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，社区和工作单位提供的易参加课程可能鼓励更多居民参与。

swap.tips: 社区与单位办课＝降低参加成本；替换句要点出「省了什么」

alts.en: Equally important, free sessions held in the neighbourhood remove the two barriers that keep people away: cost and distance.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，在社区举办的免费课程消除了让人却步的两大障碍：费用与距离。

alts.en: Equally important, when training is arranged at the office or the community centre, attending costs little more than an afternoon.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，当培训安排在办公楼或社区中心时，参加的成本不过是一个下午。

sents.en: A further driver is that practical training not only improves relevant skills, but also helps participants understand their limits and respond with greater confidence.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，实操培训不仅能提高相关技能，还能帮助参与者认清自身局限、更从容地应对。

swap.tips: 「练过」与「看过」的差别是这条的分量；两条都要写到动手

alts.en: A further driver is that a short course teaches people what they can safely do, and equally what they should leave to paramedics.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，短期课程教人明白自己能安全地做什么，也同样明白哪些应当交给急救人员。

alts.en: A further driver is the confidence that comes from having practised chest compressions on a dummy rather than only watched them online.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是，在模型上练过胸外按压、而非只在网上看过，会带来真正的底气。

sents.en: However, the figures show that participation still has considerable room to grow.
sents.cn: 不过，数据表明参与率仍有很大的提升空间。

swap.tips: 9%→32% 仍然偏低，但别写成「几乎没人参加」

alts.en: However, the figures show that most residents are still untrained, which leaves the work far from finished.
alts.cn: 然而，数据显示多数居民仍未接受培训，这项工作远未完成。

alts.en: However, the figures show that the share of trained residents remains modest, and the gap is unlikely to close by itself.
alts.cn: 然而，数据显示受训居民的比例仍然不高，而这一差距不太可能自行弥合。

blocks.v: On balance, the spread of first-aid training is a welcome gain for public safety. With more residents still to be reached, courses should stay affordable and easy to join. Qualified instructors should provide practical courses, and participants should refresh their knowledge regularly. Only through the joint efforts of communities, employers and individuals can essential emergency skills become more widely available.

sents.en: On balance, the spread of first-aid training is a welcome gain for public safety.
sents.cn: 总的来说，急救培训的普及是公共安全方面的一大收获。

swap.tips: 态度明确；下一句就转到「覆盖还不够」

alts.en: On balance, wider first-aid training is a genuine gain for public safety.
alts.cn: 总的来说，急救培训的扩大对公共安全是实实在在的收获。

alts.en: Taken as a whole, the growth of first-aid training strengthens public safety.
alts.cn: 总体来看，急救培训的增长增强了公共安全。

sents.en: With more residents still to be reached, courses should stay affordable and easy to join.
sents.cn: 仍有不少居民尚未覆盖，课程应保持低门槛、便于参加。

swap.tips: 覆盖还不够时的要求：低门槛、易参加；骨架抽掉急救专属词

alts.en: With many people still unreached, courses should stay affordable and easy to join.
alts.cn: 由于还有许多人未被覆盖，课程应保持低费用、易参加。

alts.en: To reach the rest, training must remain cheap and simple to take part in.
alts.cn: 为了覆盖其余的人，培训必须保持费用低、参与简单。

sents.en: Qualified instructors should provide practical courses, and participants should refresh their knowledge regularly.
sents.cn: 合格的教师应提供实操课程，参与者应定期更新知识。

swap.tips: 师资 + 个人复习两层；留「专业授课、定期巩固」通用骨架

alts.en: Qualified teachers should offer hands-on courses, and participants should refresh what they know regularly.
alts.cn: 合格的教师应提供实操课程，学员则应定期巩固所学。

alts.en: Skilled instructors should give practical training, while learners revisit their knowledge from time to time.
alts.cn: 有经验的讲师应提供实操培训，学习者则不温习所学。

sents.en: Only through the joint efforts of communities, employers and individuals can essential emergency skills become more widely available.
sents.cn: 只有依靠社区、雇主和个人的共同努力，基本急救技能才能更广泛地普及。

swap.tips: 三方并列（社区/雇主/个人）是这句的分量，替换时不能漏

alts.en: Essential emergency skills will spread further only if communities, employers and individuals work together.
alts.cn: 只有社区、雇主与个人共同努力，基本急救技能才会进一步普及。

alts.en: It takes communities, employers and individuals acting together to make emergency skills widely available.
alts.cn: 要让急救技能广泛可及，需要社区、雇主与个人共同行动。

items.title: 留学人员回国发展
items.en: overseas returnees developing their careers at home

blocks.v: The cartoon above depicts capped graduates flying back from abroad to China, with landmarks of the two countries below, while the chart below clearly illustrates the changes in their numbers from 2010 to 2019. During this period, the annual number of returning students rose from 134,800 to 600,000, more than quadrupling its initial level. Together, the materials highlight the growing appeal of returning home after studying abroad.

sents.en: The cartoon above depicts capped graduates flying back from abroad to China, with landmarks of the two countries below, while the chart below clearly illustrates the changes in their numbers from 2010 to 2019.
sents.cn: 上图描绘了戴着学士帽的毕业生从海外飞回中国，下方是两国的地标建筑，下图则清晰地展示了2010年至2019年他们人数的变化。

sents.en: During this period, the annual number of returning students rose from 134,800 to 600,000, more than quadrupling its initial level.
sents.cn: 在此期间，每年回国人数从13.48万上升到60万，升至最初的四倍多。

sents.en: Together, the materials highlight the growing appeal of returning home after studying abroad.
sents.cn: 这些材料共同凸显了留学后回国的吸引力不断增强。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that developments in research, technology and business provide attractive career opportunities in China. Equally important, returning students can apply what they have learned abroad while benefiting from their familiarity with the local language and culture. A further driver is the wish to live closer to family. These professional and personal considerations can jointly shape their plans.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that developments in research, technology and business provide attractive career opportunities in China.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，科研、技术和商业的发展在中国提供了有吸引力的职业机会。

swap.tips: 首要原因＝机会增多；两条都从「国内有岗位」写，别写成政策号召

alts.en: Primary among these is that the fastest-growing employers are now to be found at home rather than abroad.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，如今增长最快的雇主在国内，而不是在国外。

alts.en: Primary among these is the scale of investment in research and industry, which has created posts that did not exist a decade ago.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是科研与产业投资的规模，它创造出十年前并不存在的岗位。

sents.en: Equally important, returning students can apply what they have learned abroad while benefiting from their familiarity with the local language and culture.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，回国人员既能运用海外所学，又能受益于对本地语言和文化的熟悉。

swap.tips: 「海外所学 + 本土熟悉」是这条的两条腿，替换不能只剩一条

alts.en: Equally important, a returnee brings both overseas training and an insider understanding of the domestic market.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，回国者既带回海外训练，又懂国内市场的门道。

alts.en: Equally important, they can put foreign methods to work in a setting where they already speak the language and know the rules.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，他们能在自己本就熟悉语言与规则的环境中运用国外的方法。

sents.en: A further driver is the wish to live closer to family.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是希望离家人更近的愿望。

swap.tips: 最短的一句，替换也别拉长；两条都给一个具体的家庭画面

alts.en: A further driver is family: ageing parents, and a wish not to miss the years when children grow up.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是家庭：年迈的父母，以及不愿错过孩子成长的岁月。

alts.en: A further driver is the pull of home, where parents are getting older and close friends are starting families of their own.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是家的牵引：父母渐渐变老，好友开始组建自己的家庭。

sents.en: These professional and personal considerations can jointly shape their plans.
sents.cn: 这些职业与个人考量会共同影响他们的规划。

swap.tips: 「事业 + 家庭共同作用」是这句的结论，别写成单一原因

alts.en: Career and family rarely act alone; together they decide whether a graduate stays abroad or comes home.
alts.cn: 事业与家庭很少单独起作用，它们共同决定一个毕业生留在海外还是回国。

alts.en: What finally tips the balance is usually a mix of career prospects and family ties rather than either one on its own.
alts.cn: 最终左右决定的，通常是职业前景与家庭纽带的共同作用，而非其中任何一项。

blocks.v: On balance, the growing number of returnees is a welcome sign of a more open economy. Employers should provide fair recruitment procedures and opportunities for professional growth, while returnees should adapt their knowledge to practical needs. Universities could also involve them in joint research projects. In this way, experience gained abroad can feed into domestic industries and public services.

sents.en: On balance, the growing number of returnees is a welcome sign of a more open economy.
sents.cn: 总的来说，回国人数增加是经济更加开放的一个可喜迹象。

swap.tips: 正面表态，后面紧跟「雇主与海归各自该做什么」

alts.en: On balance, more graduates coming home is a welcome sign of a more open economy.
alts.cn: 总的来说，更多毕业生回国是一个更开放经济的可喜迹象。

alts.en: Taken as a whole, the rising number of returnees points to an economy that is opening further.
alts.cn: 总体来看，回国人数的上升表明经济正在进一步开放。

sents.en: Employers should provide fair recruitment procedures and opportunities for professional growth, while returnees should adapt their knowledge to practical needs.
sents.cn: 用人单位应提供公平的招聘流程和职业成长机会，回国人员则应让所学适应实际需求。

swap.tips: 雇主给公平机会、归国者把所学落地；骨架可迁移到任何人才题

alts.en: Employers should offer fair recruitment and room to grow, while returnees put their knowledge to practical use.
alts.cn: 雇主应提供公平招聘与成长空间，归国者则应把所学用于实际。

alts.en: Fair hiring and prospects for advancement matter, as does applying what was learned abroad to real needs.
alts.cn: 公平招聘与晋升机会很重要，把海外所学用于实际需求同样重要。

sents.en: Universities could also involve them in joint research projects.
sents.cn: 高校也可以吸纳他们参与联合研究项目。

swap.tips: 高校吸纳参与研究；骨架抽掉「留学」专属词也能套

alts.en: Universities could bring them into shared research projects.
alts.cn: 高校可以让他们参与共同的研究项目。

alts.en: Colleges might involve them in collaborative work that uses their overseas experience.
alts.cn: 高校可以让他们参与能用到海外经验的合作项目。

sents.en: In this way, experience gained abroad can feed into domestic industries and public services.
sents.cn: 这样，海外获得的经验才能反哺本国产业和公共服务。

swap.tips: In this way 承接上面的建议，后面必须是真的「这样一来」的结果

alts.en: That way, skills picked up abroad can strengthen domestic industries and public services.
alts.cn: 这样一来，在国外学到的技能就能充实国内产业与公共服务。

alts.en: With such steps, overseas experience can be put to work at home.
alts.cn: 有了这类举措，海外经验就能在国内发挥作用。

items.title: 中国人平均寿命与人口老龄化
items.en: average life expectancy and population ageing

blocks.v: The charts above clearly illustrate the changes in life expectancy and population aging in China from 2004 to 2024. During this period, average life expectancy rose from 72.54 years to 79 years. By contrast, the figure for people aged 60 and above rose from 10.97% to 22%, slightly more than doubling.

sents.en: The charts above clearly illustrate the changes in life expectancy and population aging in China from 2004 to 2024.
sents.cn: 上图清晰地展示了2004年至2024年中国人均预期寿命和人口老龄化的变化。

sents.en: During this period, average life expectancy rose from 72.54 years to 79 years.
sents.cn: 在此期间，人均预期寿命从72.54岁上升到79岁。

sents.en: By contrast, the figure for people aged 60 and above rose from 10.97% to 22%, slightly more than doubling.
sents.cn: 相比之下，60岁及以上人口比例从10.97%上升到22%，略高于翻倍。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that better living conditions and healthcare have enabled people to live longer. Equally important, lower birth rates can gradually reduce the relative size of younger generations. The figures thus reflect improvements in longevity while highlighting the need for stronger support for an aging population.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that better living conditions and healthcare have enabled people to live longer.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，更好的生活条件和医疗条件让人们活得更久。

swap.tag: 第二段原因·医疗与生活条件
swap.tips: 寿命端的原因；两条都别写成「老龄化＝出生率低」，那是下一句

alts.en: Primary among these is that nutrition, housing and medical care have improved enough to add years to ordinary lives.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，营养、住房与医疗条件的改善，已足以为普通人的生命增加年头。

alts.en: Primary among these is the steady fall in infant and middle-age mortality, which lifts the average upwards.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是婴幼儿与中年死亡率的持续下降，把平均值推高。

sents.en: Equally important, lower birth rates can gradually reduce the relative size of younger generations.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，较低的出生率会逐渐缩小年轻一代的相对规模。

swap.tips: 这条解释「占比」而不是「寿命」；替换别把死亡率和出生率混为一谈

alts.en: Equally important, fewer children are born each year, so the young make up a smaller share of the population.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，每年出生的孩子更少，年轻人在人口中所占比例因此下降。

alts.en: Equally important, birth rates have fallen faster than death rates, and that gap alone changes the age structure.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，出生率下降的速度快于死亡率，仅这一差距就改变了年龄结构。

sents.en: The figures thus reflect improvements in longevity while highlighting the need for stronger support for an aging population.
sents.cn: 因此，这些数据既反映了寿命的延长，也凸显出加强对老年人口支持的必要性。

swap.tips: 这句是「进步 + 压力」的双面收口，替换不能只剩一边

alts.en: The figures thus record a genuine advance in longevity, and at the same time they mark out the scale of future care needs.
alts.cn: 这些数据因此记录了寿命的真实进步，同时也标出了未来照护需求的规模。

alts.en: The figures thus tell two stories at once: people live longer, and the country must prepare to look after them longer.
alts.cn: 这些数据同时讲了两件事：人们活得更久，国家也必须准备更长久地照料他们。

blocks.v: On balance, longer lives are a hard-won gain, yet they put real pressure on care systems. Authorities should improve healthcare and community services, while families should provide companionship. Regular group activities would also help older people stay connected. With care systems keeping pace, this pressure can be managed rather than passed on.

sents.en: On balance, longer lives are a hard-won gain, yet they put real pressure on care systems.
sents.cn: 总的来说，寿命延长是来之不易的成果，但它给照护体系带来了实实在在的压力。

swap.tips: 双面表态：值得庆贺 + 确有压力，两边都要留

alts.en: On balance, longer lives are something to celebrate, even as they strain care systems.
alts.cn: 总的来说，寿命延长值得庆贺，即便它给照护体系带来压力。

alts.en: Taken as a whole, longer lives are a hard-won gain that nonetheless tests care systems.
alts.cn: 总体来看，寿命延长是来之不易的成果，却也考验着照护体系。

sents.en: Authorities should improve healthcare and community services, while families should provide companionship.
sents.cn: 主管部门应改善医疗和社区服务，家庭则应给予陪伴。

swap.tips: 公共部门 + 家庭各一条；骨架抽掉养老专属词，留「机构服务、家人陪伴」

alts.en: The public sector should improve care and community services, while families offer companionship.
alts.cn: 公共部门应改善照护与社区服务，家人则应给予陪伴。

alts.en: Authorities should strengthen services for the elderly, and families should stay involved in their daily lives.
alts.cn: 主管部门应加强对老年人的服务，家人则应参与他们的日常生活。

sents.en: Regular group activities would also help older people stay connected.
sents.cn: 定期的集体活动也有助于老年人保持联系。

swap.tips: 集体活动保持联结；骨架抽掉 older people 仍可用于多数群体题

alts.en: Regular group activities can also help them stay connected with others.
alts.cn: 定期的集体活动也能帮助他们与他人保持联系。

alts.en: Shared activities give older people more chances to meet and take part.
alts.cn: 集体活动让老年人有更多机会见面与参与。

sents.en: With care systems keeping pace, this pressure can be managed rather than passed on.
sents.cn: 只要照护体系跟得上，这种压力可以被管理，而不是转嫁出去。

swap.tips: 条件式收尾：体系跟上 → 压力可控，不承诺「一定解决」

alts.en: If care systems keep pace, the pressure can be managed instead of being passed on.
alts.cn: 如果照护体系跟上，这种压力可以化解，而不必转嫁。

alts.en: As long as care systems keep pace, the pressure can be contained rather than shifted.
alts.cn: 只要照护体系跟上，压力就能被控制住，而不是被转移。

items.title: 冰激凌线上与线下销售占比
items.en: online and offline ice cream sales

blocks.v: The pie charts above clearly illustrate how the shares of online and offline ice cream sales in China were distributed in 2020 and 2021. During this period, the online share rose from 5% to 20%, while the offline share fell from 95% to 80%. Although online sales gained 15 percentage points, offline purchases remained dominant.

sents.en: The pie charts above clearly illustrate how the shares of online and offline ice cream sales in China were distributed in 2020 and 2021.
sents.cn: 上面的饼图清晰地展示了2020年和2021年中国冰激凌线上与线下销售占比的分布。

sents.en: During this period, the online share rose from 5% to 20%, while the offline share fell from 95% to 80%.
sents.cn: 在此期间，线上占比从5%上升到20%，线下占比则从95%下降到80%。

sents.en: Although online sales gained 15 percentage points, offline purchases remained dominant.
sents.cn: 尽管线上销售提高了15个百分点，线下购买仍占主导。

blocks.v: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. Primary among these is that online platforms allow consumers to compare products and place orders without visiting a shop. Equally important, improvements in refrigerated delivery have made it easier to transport frozen products to customers. A further driver is that promotional offers may encourage people to try this purchasing method. Nevertheless, physical stores still provide immediate access to ice cream, which helps explain their continued importance. The figures suggest that businesses should take both channels into account when planning their sales strategies.

sents.en: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
sents.cn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。

sents.en: Primary among these is that online platforms allow consumers to compare products and place orders without visiting a shop.
sents.cn: 其中首要的一点是，线上平台让消费者无需到店就能比较商品并下单。

swap.tips: 线上优势；两条都写「一块屏上比完就下单」，别扯冷链（下一句）

alts.en: Primary among these is that a whole aisle of choices can be compared on one screen in a few minutes.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是，整整一排货架的选择，可以在几分钟内于一块屏幕上比较完。

alts.en: Primary among these is the convenience of ordering from home, where price, flavour and reviews sit side by side.
alts.cn: 首要的一点是在家下单的便利：价格、口味与评价并列呈现在眼前。

sents.en: Equally important, improvements in refrigerated delivery have made it easier to transport frozen products to customers.
sents.cn: 同样重要的是，冷链配送的改善使冷冻产品更容易送到消费者手中。

swap.tips: 冷链解决「会不会化」；替换句别写成快递时效或价格

alts.en: Equally important, insulated packaging and cold-chain couriers now keep ice cream firm even in midsummer.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，保温包装与冷链配送让冰激凌在盛夏也能保持完好。

alts.en: Equally important, the cold chain has become reliable enough for a product that melts within minutes of rough handling.
alts.cn: 同样重要的是，冷链已足够可靠，足以应付一种处置不当几分钟就会融化的商品。

sents.en: A further driver is that promotional offers may encourage people to try this purchasing method.
sents.cn: 另一个推动因素是，促销活动可能会鼓励人们尝试这种购买方式。

swap.tips: 这条讲「第一次尝试」的门槛；别写成长期低价竞争

alts.en: A further driver is the discount that appears at checkout, which lowers the risk of trying an unfamiliar channel.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是结账时出现的折扣，它降低了尝试一个陌生渠道的风险。

alts.en: A further driver is the coupons and free-delivery thresholds that make a first online order seem worth trying.
alts.cn: 另一个推动因素是优惠券与免运费门槛，让第一次线上下单看起来值得一试。

sents.en: Nevertheless, physical stores still provide immediate access to ice cream, which helps explain their continued importance.
sents.cn: 尽管如此，实体店仍能让人立即买到冰激凌，这有助于解释其持续的重要性。

swap.tips: 线上只占两成，这句守的是线下的位置；替换别写成线下会消失

alts.en: Nevertheless, a shop still wins on one point that delivery cannot match: the ice cream is in your hand within a minute.
alts.cn: 然而，实体店仍有一项配送无法比拟的优势：一分钟内冰激凌就在手里。

alts.en: Nevertheless, when the craving is immediate, a walk to the freezer aisle beats any delivery time.
alts.cn: 然而，当嘴馋是即刻的，走到冰柜货架比任何配送时间都更划算。

sents.en: The figures suggest that businesses should take both channels into account when planning their sales strategies.
sents.cn: 这些数据表明，企业在制定销售策略时应兼顾两个渠道。

swap.tips: 收「两个渠道都要」，别写成线上取代线下

alts.en: The figures suggest that neither channel can be treated as an afterthought when a brand plans its sales.
alts.cn: 这些数据表明，品牌规划销售时，两个渠道都不能被当作附带事项。

alts.en: The figures suggest that firms should sell through both channels rather than choose between them.
alts.cn: 这些数据表明，企业应同时经营两个渠道，而不是在两者之间做选择。

blocks.v: On balance, online sales have grown quickly yet remain a small part of the market. Buying online is convenient, but it raises questions about quality and delivery. Verified product information and dependable refund rules would help build trust. How well the two channels complement each other will shape the market in the years ahead.

sents.en: On balance, online sales have grown quickly yet remain a small part of the market.
sents.cn: 总的来说，线上销售增长迅速，但在市场中仍只占一小部分。

swap.tips: 「涨得快但仍不占主导」是核心事实，替换别写成单边上升

alts.en: On balance, online sales have risen fast but still account for a small share of the market.
alts.cn: 总的来说，线上销售增长迅速，但仍只占市场的一小部分。

alts.en: Taken as a whole, the online channel has grown quickly without overtaking offline sales.
alts.cn: 总体来看，线上渠道增长很快，但并未超过线下销售。

sents.en: Buying online is convenient, but it raises questions about quality and delivery.
sents.cn: 线上购买带来了便利，但也引发了关于品质和配送的疑问。

swap.tips: 线上便利但引出疑虑；「方便却带来质量/交付疑问」是可迁移骨架

alts.en: Shopping online is convenient, yet it raises questions about quality and delivery.
alts.cn: 网上购物很方便，却也引出质量与配送方面的疑问。

alts.en: The ease of buying online comes with doubts about what arrives and how it is delivered.
alts.cn: 线上购买的便利，伴随着对到手商品与配送方式的疑虑。

sents.en: Verified product information and dependable refund rules would help build trust.
sents.cn: 经过核实的产品信息和可靠的退款规则有助于建立信任。

swap.tips: 信息透明 + 退换保障建立信任；骨架抽掉冰激凌专属词

alts.en: Clear product information and reliable refund rules would help build trust.
alts.cn: 清晰的商品信息与可靠的退换规则，有助于建立信任。

alts.en: Trust grows when buyers can check what they purchase and count on fair refunds.
alts.cn: 当买家能核实所购商品、并指望得到公正退换时，信任就会增长。

sents.en: How well the two channels complement each other will shape the market in the years ahead.
sents.cn: 两种渠道能否互补，将决定未来市场的走向。

swap.tips: 收尾把判断落在「两个渠道配合得好不好」

alts.en: Whether the two channels work well together will shape the market in the years to come.
alts.cn: 两个渠道能否良好互补，将塑造未来几年的市场。

alts.en: The future of the market rests on how well online convenience and offline service are combined.
alts.cn: 市场的未来取决于线上便利与线下服务能否结合得好。

items.title: 人工智能工具的使用
items.en: the use of AI tools

notes.en: AI is such a great help!
the answer has been generated
homework already "finished"

blocks.v: The cartoon above presents us with a thought-provoking scene: a student is delighted with an AI tool that has generated answers to his homework. The caption suggests that the assignment is already complete. The drawing invites us to reflect on whether finishing a task necessarily means learning something.

sents.en: The cartoon above presents us with a thought-provoking scene: a student is delighted with an AI tool that has generated answers to his homework.
sents.cn: 上图向我们展现了一幕发人深省的场景：一名学生因人工智能工具为他生成了作业答案而喜出望外。

sents.en: The caption suggests that the assignment is already complete.
sents.cn: 图上的文字表明作业已经完成。

sents.en: The drawing invites us to reflect on whether finishing a task necessarily means learning something.
sents.cn: 这幅画促使我们思考，完成任务是否必然意味着学到了东西。

blocks.v: There is no doubt that artificial intelligence can make learning more efficient. Not only does it provide quick explanations, but it also enables students to explore unfamiliar subjects. However, we cannot ignore the fact that excessive dependence on ready-made answers may weaken independent thinking. If students simply submit generated content without checking or understanding it, they miss the opportunity to develop their own abilities. Moreover, inaccurate answers may mislead users who lack sufficient knowledge to evaluate them.

sents.en: There is no doubt that artificial intelligence can make learning more efficient.
sents.cn: 毫无疑问，人工智能能让学习更高效。

sents.en: Not only does it provide quick explanations, but it also enables students to explore unfamiliar subjects.
sents.cn: 它不仅能快速给出解释，还能让学生探索陌生的领域。

sents.en: However, we cannot ignore the fact that excessive dependence on ready-made answers may weaken independent thinking.
sents.cn: 然而，我们不能忽视这样一个事实：过度依赖现成答案可能削弱独立思考。

sents.en: If students simply submit generated content without checking or understanding it, they miss the opportunity to develop their own abilities.
sents.cn: 如果学生不加核对或理解就提交生成的内容，他们就失去了发展自身能力的机会。

sents.en: Moreover, inaccurate answers may mislead users who lack sufficient knowledge to evaluate them.
sents.cn: 此外，错误的答案还可能误导那些缺乏足够知识去辨别的用户。

blocks.v: We should bear in mind that independent thinking is of great importance to our personal development. Students should attempt problems first and use AI to review their reasoning. Teachers should also explain the proper boundaries of its use. Only through the joint efforts of teachers and students can we turn technological convenience into meaningful educational progress.

sents.en: We should bear in mind that independent thinking is of great importance to our personal development.
sents.cn: 我们应当记住，独立思考对个人发展至关重要。

sents.en: Students should attempt problems first and use AI to review their reasoning.
sents.cn: 学生应先自己尝试解题，再用人工智能检查推理过程。

sents.en: Teachers should also explain the proper boundaries of its use.
sents.cn: 教师也应说明其使用的恰当边界。

sents.en: Only through the joint efforts of teachers and students can we turn technological convenience into meaningful educational progress.
sents.cn: 只有师生共同努力，我们才能把技术上的便利转化为真正有意义的教育进步。

items.title: “陪着”不等于“陪伴”
items.en: "staying around" vs. "companionship"

notes.en: Dad, are you listening to me?
"Staying around" is not companionship.

blocks.v: As is symbolically depicted in the cartoon above, a father sits beside his son but keeps his eyes on his mobile phone. The boy asks whether his father is listening. The caption beneath the drawing reminds us that being physically present does not necessarily mean providing real companionship.

sents.en: As is symbolically depicted in the cartoon above, a father sits beside his son but keeps his eyes on his mobile phone.
sents.cn: 如上图所示，一位父亲坐在儿子身旁，眼睛却一直盯着手机。

sents.en: The boy asks whether his father is listening.
sents.cn: 男孩问父亲是否在听他说话。

sents.en: The caption beneath the drawing reminds us that being physically present does not necessarily mean providing real companionship.
sents.cn: 画下的文字提醒我们，人在身边并不一定意味着真正的陪伴。

blocks.v: What is clearly conveyed in the picture is that family relationships require attention and communication. For one thing, children need opportunities to share their experiences and feelings with their parents. Careful listening helps them feel understood and supported. For another, frequent distractions may discourage children from speaking openly, gradually weakening mutual trust. A parent who repeatedly chooses a screen over a conversation also sets an example that children may follow in their own relationships.

sents.en: What is clearly conveyed in the picture is that family relationships require attention and communication.
sents.cn: 这幅图清楚传达的信息是，家庭关系需要关注和交流。

sents.en: For one thing, children need opportunities to share their experiences and feelings with their parents.
sents.cn: 一方面，孩子需要机会与父母分享自己的经历和感受。

sents.en: Careful listening helps them feel understood and supported.
sents.cn: 认真倾听能让他们感到被理解、被支持。

sents.en: For another, frequent distractions may discourage children from speaking openly, gradually weakening mutual trust.
sents.cn: 另一方面，频繁的走神会让孩子不愿敞开心扉，逐渐削弱彼此的信任。

sents.en: A parent who repeatedly chooses a screen over a conversation also sets an example that children may follow in their own relationships.
sents.cn: 一个总把屏幕置于对话之上的家长，也为孩子日后处理人际关系树立了一个可能效仿的榜样。

blocks.v: We should bear in mind that meaningful companionship is of great importance to family life. Parents should put their phones aside during meals and conversations and make time for activities with their children. Such changes do not necessarily require much money or elaborate plans. Only through consistent attention and patient communication can we build closer and more lasting family bonds.

sents.en: We should bear in mind that meaningful companionship is of great importance to family life.
sents.cn: 我们应当记住，有意义的陪伴对家庭生活至关重要。

sents.en: Parents should put their phones aside during meals and conversations and make time for activities with their children.
sents.cn: 家长应在吃饭和交谈时放下手机，并抽出时间与孩子一起活动。

sents.en: Such changes do not necessarily require much money or elaborate plans.
sents.cn: 这些改变未必需要很多钱或周密的计划。

sents.en: Only through consistent attention and patient communication can we build closer and more lasting family bonds.
sents.cn: 只有持续关注和耐心沟通，我们才能建立更亲密、更持久的家庭纽带。

items.title: 压力与身心健康
items.en: stress and physical and mental health

notes.en: a poster reading "pressure"

blocks.v: Depicted in the picture above is a scene that strikes us as both familiar and thought-provoking: a man sits at a desk with his head lowered, surrounded by documents and reminders. The word "pressure" appears prominently above him. The drawing highlights the burden that excessive stress can place on daily life.

sents.en: Depicted in the picture above is a scene that strikes us as both familiar and thought-provoking: a man sits at a desk with his head lowered, surrounded by documents and reminders.
sents.cn: 上图描绘的场景既熟悉又发人深省：一名男子低头坐在桌前，周围堆满文件和待办提醒。

sents.en: The word "pressure" appears prominently above him.
sents.cn: “压力”一词醒目地出现在他头顶上方。

sents.en: The drawing highlights the burden that excessive stress can place on daily life.
sents.cn: 这幅画突出了过度压力可能给日常生活带来的负担。

blocks.v: Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, demanding schedules and intense competition may leave people with little time to rest. Furthermore, some people set unrealistic expectations for themselves and regard every setback as a personal failure. We cannot ignore the fact that prolonged stress can harm both physical and mental health. It may also reduce concentration and efficiency, making unfinished tasks even harder to manage.

sents.en: Several factors contribute to this phenomenon.
sents.cn: 造成这一现象的原因有多个。

sents.en: First and foremost, demanding schedules and intense competition may leave people with little time to rest.
sents.cn: 首先，紧张的日程和激烈的竞争让人们几乎没有时间休息。

sents.en: Furthermore, some people set unrealistic expectations for themselves and regard every setback as a personal failure.
sents.cn: 此外，有些人对自己设定不切实际的期望，把每一次挫折都当成个人失败。

sents.en: We cannot ignore the fact that prolonged stress can harm both physical and mental health.
sents.cn: 我们不能忽视这样一个事实：长期压力会损害身心健康。

sents.en: It may also reduce concentration and efficiency, making unfinished tasks even harder to manage.
sents.cn: 它还会降低专注度和效率，让未完成的任务更难处理。

blocks.v: It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be paid to stress management. Individuals should set reasonable priorities, take regular breaks and seek support when necessary. Employers should also distribute tasks fairly and respect reasonable working hours. Only through the joint efforts of individuals and organizations can we achieve a healthier balance between productive work and personal well-being.

sents.en: It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be paid to stress management.
sents.cn: 不难得出结论：必须充分重视压力管理。

sents.en: Individuals should set reasonable priorities, take regular breaks and seek support when necessary.
sents.cn: 个人应设定合理的优先事项、定期休息，并在必要时寻求帮助。

sents.en: Employers should also distribute tasks fairly and respect reasonable working hours.
sents.cn: 用人单位也应公平分配任务，尊重合理的工作时间。

sents.en: Only through the joint efforts of individuals and organizations can we achieve a healthier balance between productive work and personal well-being.
sents.cn: 只有个人和组织共同努力，我们才能在工作成效与个人福祉之间取得更健康的平衡。

items.title: 过度包装与绿色消费
items.en: over-packaging and green consumption

notes.zh: 买个礼物需要这么多包装？
notes.en: Does one gift really need all this packaging?

blocks.v: The cartoon above presents us with a thought-provoking scene: a person stands beside a pile of boxes and wonders why buying one gift requires so much packaging. The contrast between the small purchase and the large amount of wrapping highlights the problem of excessive packaging.

sents.en: The cartoon above presents us with a thought-provoking scene: a person stands beside a pile of boxes and wonders why buying one gift requires so much packaging.
sents.cn: 上图向我们展现了一幕发人深省的场景：一个人站在一堆盒子旁，纳闷为什么买一件礼物需要这么多包装。

sents.en: The contrast between the small purchase and the large amount of wrapping highlights the problem of excessive packaging.
sents.cn: 小小的商品与大量包装之间的反差，凸显了过度包装的问题。

blocks.v: Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. For one thing, some businesses use elaborate packages to make ordinary products appear more valuable. For another, some consumers associate attractive wrapping with quality or respect for the recipient. However, we cannot ignore the fact that unnecessary packaging consumes resources and creates waste. It also adds to the price consumers pay, while offering little practical benefit once the product has been opened.

sents.en: Several factors contribute to this phenomenon.
sents.cn: 造成这一现象的原因有多个。

sents.en: For one thing, some businesses use elaborate packages to make ordinary products appear more valuable.
sents.cn: 一方面，一些商家用华丽的包装让普通商品显得更有价值。

sents.en: For another, some consumers associate attractive wrapping with quality or respect for the recipient.
sents.cn: 另一方面，一些消费者把漂亮的包装与品质或对收礼人的尊重联系在一起。

sents.en: However, we cannot ignore the fact that unnecessary packaging consumes resources and creates waste.
sents.cn: 然而，我们不能忽视这样一个事实：不必要的包装消耗资源并制造垃圾。

sents.en: It also adds to the price consumers pay, while offering little practical benefit once the product has been opened.
sents.cn: 它还抬高了消费者支付的价格，而商品拆开后几乎没有什么实际益处。

blocks.v: We should bear in mind that responsible consumption is of great importance to environmental protection. Businesses should use simple packaging that protects products effectively, and consumers should pay more attention to usefulness than to appearance. Authorities can encourage recyclable materials and discourage wasteful practices. If these proposed measures are implemented, a harmonious balance between commercial development and environmental protection will be within our reach.

sents.en: We should bear in mind that responsible consumption is of great importance to environmental protection.
sents.cn: 我们应当记住，负责任消费对环境保护至关重要。

sents.en: Businesses should use simple packaging that protects products effectively, and consumers should pay more attention to usefulness than to appearance.
sents.cn: 商家应使用既能有效保护商品又简洁的包装，消费者应更注重实用性而非外观。

sents.en: Authorities can encourage recyclable materials and discourage wasteful practices.
sents.cn: 主管部门可以鼓励使用可回收材料，遏制浪费性做法。

sents.en: If these proposed measures are implemented, a harmonious balance between commercial development and environmental protection will be within our reach.
sents.cn: 如果这些建议的措施得以实施，商业发展与环境保护之间的和谐平衡就离我们不远了。

items.title: 网络信息与理性辨别
items.en: online information and rational judgement

notes.en: online information
labels reading "true" and "false"

notes.zh: 诚信：网络信息真假难辨
notes.en: Honesty: online information is hard to tell true from false.

blocks.v: As is symbolically depicted in the cartoon above, a confused man faces a computer surrounded by conflicting messages. The caption points to the difficulty of distinguishing reliable online information from falsehoods. The drawing raises an important question about honesty and judgment in the digital age.

sents.en: As is symbolically depicted in the cartoon above, a confused man faces a computer surrounded by conflicting messages.
sents.cn: 如上图所示，一名困惑的男子面对着一台电脑，周围充斥着相互矛盾的信息。

sents.en: The caption points to the difficulty of distinguishing reliable online information from falsehoods.
sents.cn: 图上文字指出，很难辨别网络上可靠的信息与虚假内容。

sents.en: The drawing raises an important question about honesty and judgment in the digital age.
sents.cn: 这幅画提出了一个关于数字时代诚信与判断力的重要问题。

blocks.v: Several factors contribute to this phenomenon. First and foremost, information can spread rapidly online before anyone has checked its accuracy. Furthermore, some content creators exaggerate facts or invent stories to attract attention. We cannot ignore the fact that misleading messages may influence personal decisions and damage public trust. Without the habit of examining evidence, users may unintentionally help false information reach a wider audience by sharing it with others.

sents.en: Several factors contribute to this phenomenon.
sents.cn: 造成这一现象的原因有多个。

sents.en: First and foremost, information can spread rapidly online before anyone has checked its accuracy.
sents.cn: 首先，信息往往在无人核实其准确性之前就在网上传播开来。

sents.en: Furthermore, some content creators exaggerate facts or invent stories to attract attention.
sents.cn: 此外，一些内容创作者夸大事实或编造故事以吸引眼球。

sents.en: We cannot ignore the fact that misleading messages may influence personal decisions and damage public trust.
sents.cn: 我们不能忽视这样一个事实：误导性信息可能影响个人决策并损害公众信任。

sents.en: Without the habit of examining evidence, users may unintentionally help false information reach a wider audience by sharing it with others.
sents.cn: 如果没有核查证据的习惯，用户可能在转发时不经意间帮助虚假信息传播给更多人。

blocks.v: We should bear in mind that honesty is of great importance to online communication. Users should check sources, compare reports and avoid forwarding doubtful claims. Content creators should take responsibility for accuracy, while platforms should make corrections visible and provide effective reporting channels. Only through the joint efforts of users, creators and platforms can we build an online environment in which reliable information receives the attention it deserves.

sents.en: We should bear in mind that honesty is of great importance to online communication.
sents.cn: 我们应当记住，诚信对网络交流至关重要。

sents.en: Users should check sources, compare reports and avoid forwarding doubtful claims.
sents.cn: 用户应核查来源、比对报道，避免转发存疑的说法。

sents.en: Content creators should take responsibility for accuracy, while platforms should make corrections visible and provide effective reporting channels.
sents.cn: 内容创作者应对准确性负责，平台则应让更正信息可见，并提供有效的举报渠道。

sents.en: Only through the joint efforts of users, creators and platforms can we build an online environment in which reliable information receives the attention it deserves.
sents.cn: 只有用户、创作者和平台共同努力，我们才能营造出可靠信息获得应有重视的网络环境。

items.title: 中国传统艺术的传承
items.en: the inheritance of traditional Chinese art

notes.en: the inheritance of traditional Chinese art

blocks.v: The pictures above present us with thought-provoking scenes of traditional Chinese art being passed on. In the first picture, an older artist demonstrates a traditional skill to a young learner. In the second, the younger generation shares and practices the art. The caption emphasizes the importance of preserving this cultural inheritance.

sents.en: The pictures above present us with thought-provoking scenes of traditional Chinese art being passed on.
sents.cn: 上面的图片向我们展现了中国传统艺术得以传承的动人场景。

sents.en: In the first picture, an older artist demonstrates a traditional skill to a young learner.
sents.cn: 第一幅图中，一位年长的艺人向年轻学习者演示一项传统技艺。

sents.en: In the second, the younger generation shares and practices the art.
sents.cn: 第二幅图中，年轻一代在分享并练习这门艺术。

sents.en: The caption emphasizes the importance of preserving this cultural inheritance.
sents.cn: 图上文字强调了保护这一文化传承的重要性。

blocks.v: There is no doubt that traditional arts are valuable resources for cultural development. For one thing, they embody the knowledge, creativity and experience of earlier generations. Learning these skills helps young people understand the culture behind familiar designs and objects. For another, direct teaching enables techniques that are difficult to record in words to survive. Without new learners and opportunities for practice, even highly respected forms of art may gradually disappear from everyday life.

sents.en: There is no doubt that traditional arts are valuable resources for cultural development.
sents.cn: 毫无疑问，传统艺术是文化发展的宝贵资源。

sents.en: For one thing, they embody the knowledge, creativity and experience of earlier generations.
sents.cn: 一方面，它们凝聚着前人的知识、创造力与经验。

sents.en: Learning these skills helps young people understand the culture behind familiar designs and objects.
sents.cn: 学习这些技艺有助于年轻人理解熟悉图案和器物背后的文化。

sents.en: For another, direct teaching enables techniques that are difficult to record in words to survive.
sents.cn: 另一方面，师徒相传使那些难以用文字记录的手法得以延续。

sents.en: Without new learners and opportunities for practice, even highly respected forms of art may gradually disappear from everyday life.
sents.cn: 如果没有新的学习者和练习机会，即使是备受推崇的艺术形式也可能逐渐从日常生活中消失。

blocks.v: We should bear in mind that cultural inheritance requires active participation. Schools and communities should invite skilled artists to offer practical workshops, while young people should approach these traditions with curiosity and patience. Thoughtful innovation can also connect traditional skills with contemporary needs. In this way, cultural heritage can remain a living source of inspiration for future generations.

sents.en: We should bear in mind that cultural inheritance requires active participation.
sents.cn: 我们应当记住，文化传承需要积极参与。

sents.en: Schools and communities should invite skilled artists to offer practical workshops, while young people should approach these traditions with curiosity and patience.
sents.cn: 学校和社区应邀请技艺精湛的艺术家开设实践工作坊，年轻人则应带着好奇与耐心对待这些传统。

sents.en: Thoughtful innovation can also connect traditional skills with contemporary needs.
sents.cn: 用心的创新也能让传统技艺与当代需求相连接。

sents.en: In this way, cultural heritage can remain a living source of inspiration for future generations.
sents.cn: 这样，文化遗产就能成为滋养后代灵感的活水。

items.title: 热门与热爱
items.en: popularity vs. genuine passion

notes.zh: 这个专业需求旺盛，前景广阔！
notes.en: This major is in great demand and has bright prospects!
I am truly passionate about this major.
popular emerging positions
a guide to popular majors
popularity vs. genuine passion

blocks.v: The pictures above present two considerations when choosing a major. In the first, a student is attracted by strong market demand and promising career prospects. In the second, another student expresses enthusiasm for a particular subject. The contrast invites us to reflect on the relationship between popularity and personal interest.

sents.en: The pictures above present two considerations when choosing a major.
sents.cn: 上面的图片呈现了选择专业时的两种考量。

sents.en: In the first, a student is attracted by strong market demand and promising career prospects.
sents.cn: 第一幅图中，一名学生被旺盛的市场需求和光明的职业前景所吸引。

sents.en: In the second, another student expresses enthusiasm for a particular subject.
sents.cn: 第二幅图中，另一名学生表达了对某一专业的热爱。

sents.en: The contrast invites us to reflect on the relationship between popularity and personal interest.
sents.cn: 这种对比促使我们思考热门与个人兴趣之间的关系。

blocks.v: There is no doubt that both considerations deserve attention. For one thing, employment prospects matter because higher education should help students prepare for their future working lives. For another, genuine interest can encourage sustained effort, especially when learning becomes difficult. We cannot ignore the fact that a currently popular major may lose its advantage as economic conditions change. Equally, enthusiasm alone cannot replace a realistic understanding of course requirements and professional opportunities.

sents.en: There is no doubt that both considerations deserve attention.
sents.cn: 毫无疑问，这两种考量都值得重视。

sents.en: For one thing, employment prospects matter because higher education should help students prepare for their future working lives.
sents.cn: 一方面，就业前景很重要，因为高等教育应帮助学生为未来的职业生涯做好准备。

sents.en: For another, genuine interest can encourage sustained effort, especially when learning becomes difficult.
sents.cn: 另一方面，真正的兴趣能激励持续努力，尤其是在学习变得困难的时候。

sents.en: We cannot ignore the fact that a currently popular major may lose its advantage as economic conditions change.
sents.cn: 我们不能忽视这样一个事实：当前热门的专业可能随着经济形势变化而失去优势。

sents.en: Equally, enthusiasm alone cannot replace a realistic understanding of course requirements and professional opportunities.
sents.cn: 同样，仅有热情也不能替代对课程要求和职业机会的现实认识。

blocks.v: We should bear in mind that a suitable choice is of great importance to personal development. Students should assess their interests and abilities, investigate the curriculum and seek advice from teachers and professionals. Universities should also provide clear information about different paths. By combining self-knowledge with careful research, young people can choose a direction that supports both meaningful learning and future employment.

sents.en: We should bear in mind that a suitable choice is of great importance to personal development.
sents.cn: 我们应当记住，合适的选择对个人发展至关重要。

sents.en: Students should assess their interests and abilities, investigate the curriculum and seek advice from teachers and professionals.
sents.cn: 学生应评估自己的兴趣和能力，了解课程设置，并向老师和专业人士请教。

sents.en: Universities should also provide clear information about different paths.
sents.cn: 大学也应提供关于不同发展路径的清晰信息。

sents.en: By combining self-knowledge with careful research, young people can choose a direction that supports both meaningful learning and future employment.
sents.cn: 通过把自我认知与仔细调研结合起来，年轻人就能选出一个既带来有意义学习、又能支持未来就业的方向。

items.title: 旅游发展与环境保护
items.en: tourism development and environmental protection

notes.en: in the past / at present
the entrance to the scenic area

blocks.v: The pictures above present a striking contrast between a scenic area in the past and the same place today. The earlier scene features a peaceful natural landscape, whereas the later one shows crowded tourist facilities, numerous boats and scattered rubbish. The contrast highlights the environmental cost of poorly managed tourism.

sents.en: The pictures above present a striking contrast between a scenic area in the past and the same place today.
sents.cn: 上面的图片形成鲜明对比：一处是过去的景区，另一处是如今的同一地点。

sents.en: The earlier scene features a peaceful natural landscape, whereas the later one shows crowded tourist facilities, numerous boats and scattered rubbish.
sents.cn: 早先的画面是宁静的自然景观，而后来则展现出拥挤的旅游设施、众多船只和散落的垃圾。

sents.en: The contrast highlights the environmental cost of poorly managed tourism.
sents.cn: 这种对比凸显了管理不善的旅游业所付出的环境代价。

blocks.v: Several factors contribute to this problem. First and foremost, a rapid increase in visitor numbers can place pressure on natural resources and waste disposal facilities. Furthermore, some operators focus on immediate income while giving insufficient attention to environmental protection. We cannot ignore the fact that careless behavior by individual tourists can also damage the landscape. If these problems continue, the area may lose the very qualities that originally attracted visitors.

sents.en: Several factors contribute to this problem.
sents.cn: 造成这一问题的原因有多个。

sents.en: First and foremost, a rapid increase in visitor numbers can place pressure on natural resources and waste disposal facilities.
sents.cn: 首先，游客数量的快速增长会给自然资源和垃圾处理设施带来压力。

sents.en: Furthermore, some operators focus on immediate income while giving insufficient attention to environmental protection.
sents.cn: 此外，一些经营者只顾眼前收入，对环境保护关注不足。

sents.en: We cannot ignore the fact that careless behavior by individual tourists can also damage the landscape.
sents.cn: 我们不能忽视这样一个事实：个别游客的随意行为也会破坏景观。

sents.en: If these problems continue, the area may lose the very qualities that originally attracted visitors.
sents.cn: 如果这些问题持续下去，该景区可能失去当初吸引游客的特质。

blocks.v: By no means should we give up our efforts to protect the environment. Authorities should manage visitor numbers and improve waste collection, while operators should adopt responsible business practices. Tourists should also avoid littering and respect local rules. If these proposed measures are implemented, a harmonious balance between tourism development and environmental protection will be within our reach.

sents.en: By no means should we give up our efforts to protect the environment.
sents.cn: 我们绝不能放弃保护环境的努力。

sents.en: Authorities should manage visitor numbers and improve waste collection, while operators should adopt responsible business practices.
sents.cn: 主管部门应管控游客数量并改善垃圾收集，经营者应采取负责任的经营方式。

sents.en: Tourists should also avoid littering and respect local rules.
sents.cn: 游客也应避免乱扔垃圾，遵守当地规定。

sents.en: If these proposed measures are implemented, a harmonious balance between tourism development and environmental protection will be within our reach.
sents.cn: 如果这些建议的措施得以实施，旅游发展与环境保护之间的和谐平衡就离我们不远了。
